page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, which provides 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the combination of dedicated AMD EPYC processing power, a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and an NVIDIA L20 GPU, this server is designed for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
